_comment: Phase B / item 7. objection_handler.py matches user message text against trigger_phrases (case-insensitive substring/fuzzy match) for each objection_type, returns resolution_template, and optionally calls linked_action. Add new objection types/phrases here without touching code.

objections.resolution_template: I completely understand — budget matters. We do have Ready to Ship pieces starting lower, and Choose & Customize lets you control cost by picking fabric/embroidery tiers. Want me to show you options in your budget?

Totally fair to ask — timing matters for a wedding. Ready to Ship pieces can go out within a few days. For Custom or Bespoke, tell me your wedding date and I'll confirm if we can make the timeline work.
Good question — fit is everything for a bridal outfit. Let me check current stock in your size, and know that Choose & Customize and Bespoke are made to your exact measurements.

Happy to reassure you on that — every piece lists its fabric and embroidery details on the product page, and our Custom/Bespoke tiers let you choose premium materials directly. Want me to pull up the fabric details for something you liked?
No pressure at all — take your time. I can save your favorites to a shortlist so they're here whenever you're ready, and you can always come back to continue.

Great question — I'll confirm our current return/exchange policy for your specific order type (Ready to Ship vs Custom/Bespoke have different terms), so you know exactly what to expect before you decide.
